trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: There is no task of its own here — the platinum is the game's stamp on the other 54 trophies, and it appears the instant the last one of them lands. Work the roadmap from the top — story, then strangers, then collectibles and activities — and let this one take care of itself.
steps: Clear the other 54 trophies in whatever order suits the roadmap.
Watch for the platinum the moment the final trophy pops.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold, and the long haul: 100% completion. Rockstar has never published what the 100% checklist holds, so no guide can honestly spell out its tasks — the shape is visible in the other trophies (story, strangers, collectibles, activities, robberies, money, exploration), and the in-game stats page is the real checklist once you are playing. Any circulating '35-task' figure is unverified and should not be trusted.
steps: Finish the story, the stranger strands and the open-world trophy blocks.
Open the in-game 100% stats page and work whatever it still lists.
Treat any website's claimed task list as unverified until the game itself confirms it.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: 250 stunts, and the counter runs from the first drive: jumps, near misses, drifts and air time all feed it, so ordinary play already banks a share. The smart way is to let it grow through the story and then grind what is left in free roam, at a spot with a solid ramp and a fast car, instead of forcing it mission by mission.
steps: Stunt through normal play — jumps, near misses, drifts and air time all count.
After the story, finish the remaining count in free roam with a ramp and a fast car.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and mind the one that can disappear. Several guides agree that the spot on Lucia's balcony is only reachable during Chapter 1, and with no mission replay and no New Game+, missing it strands the trophy: meditate there before Chapter 1 ends and keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops. Past that one spot, no other missable has been confirmed — PlanetGTA6 is explicit that no reliable missable list exists yet — so treat this as the single trophy that needs a save, and the other spots as ordinary cleanup.
steps: During Chapter 1, meditate at the balcony spot before the chapter ends.
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by: knock someone over with a melee weapon swung from a moving vehicle. The bowling pun is the instruction — line up a target, swing as you pass, and the trophy is the connection. Slow down for it: a straight road at low speed lands the hit far more reliably than full throttle, and one clean hit is all it takes.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a target and land a melee hit from the car.

It rides along with the robbery trophies: rob, launder, repeat, and a quarter of a million shows up as a side effect of the vaults and trucks.
